verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own marketing page says it supports signing commits, so the product itself has the capability. That is the only mention, and nothing says which key type (GPG or SSH) is used for signing or how verification works. The SSH identity and Secure Enclave key docs cover authentication keys, not commit signing, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of GPG or SSH signing key types, setup steps, verification display on hosting providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sign my commits with a GPG or SSH key for verification

citations.quote: Take part in secure workflows by signing commits.
